Features

Research takes many forms

Whether you need a quick answer or are planning a multi-month comprehensive review, Elicit can support you from beginning to end.

Research agent

  • Built for high-stakes decisions and rigorous research workflows.

How we’re different

There are a lot of AI tools out there. What makes Elicit unique?

Scale

Elicit can find up to 1,000 relevant papers and analyze up to 20,000 data points at once.

Accuracy

Elicit is the most accurate AI product for scientific research. Learn about how we validated Elicit's accuracy.

Transparency

Elicit supports all AI-generated claims with sentence-level citations from the underlying sources.

More than chat

Elicit goes beyond chat to provide rich, interactive tables and multi-step workflows.

New features

Latest releases

  • Sep 30, 2026

    Introducing Routines: Research that keeps working

    Tell the Elicit Research Agent what to keep current. Routines find new evidence, update your work, and report back for your review.

  • Sep 17, 2026

    Turn your Elicit Library into a shared research hub

    Today, we’re evolving the Elicit Library into a shared research hub where researchers and AI agents can work from the same evidence.

  • Aug 31, 2026

    AI-powered research is now multiplayer

    We believe three principles are especially important for making AI-powered research more collaborative

  • Aug 4, 2026

    BioDecisionBench: Can models reason through the narrow path to drug development success?

    Elicit Research Agent sets the frontier on our new decision-making benchmark for AI in the life sciences

  • Aug 4, 2026

    Introducing Elicit Research Agent: Rigor that powers decisions

    Elicit Research Agent is an AI environment built for high-stakes decisions

  • Jul 17, 2026

    Evaluating Elicit’s Paper Search

    Elicit outperformed five other search systems on BioASQ, retrieving more of the papers biomedical experts rely on.

  • Jul 15, 2026

    The Elicit API and MCP: Powering autonomous research engines

    The Elicit API and MCP server bring Elicit’s trusted capabilities to your agents and workflows.

  • Jun 30, 2026

    A more powerful Research Agent, with updated usage limits

    Our Research Agent can do significantly more work and use more data sources, Elicit is moving from workflow-based limits to a monthly usage pool

Case studies

Trusted by top research institutions

Our team and our customers have rigorously tested and evaluated Elicit's accuracy

  • While developing a clinical asset targeting knee osteoarthritis, Formation Bio used Elicit to assess how end-stage knee osteoarthritis had been defined in clinical trials and previous literature.

    1,600

    Papers to extract data from

    10x

    Faster in Elicit

  • VDI / VDE used Elicit's data extraction for a systematic review informing German education policy. Elicit correctly extracted 1,502 out of 1,511 data points, an accuracy rate of 99.4%.

    99.4%

    Data extraction accuracy

    11x

    More evidence considered

  • Oxford PharmaGenesis advises 8 of the top 10 global pharmaceutical companies. With Elicit, they now deliver literature reviews at an unprecedented scale.

    500

This is an important moment in time

AI has the potential to significantly change the world. Change is complicated. As researchers and scientists, we must direct this technology towards having as positive an impact as possible. We need to move quickly, without sacrificing quality. Our research needs to be more dynamic to stay relevant in a rapidly-changing world.

Scientific rigor, good reasoning, and high-quality research are more important than ever.

We built this to help you. To help you understand the never-ending mysteries of our universe. To help you make breakthroughs that end disease. To help you wrestle with hard questions about how to alleviate poverty, explore new frontiers, or create thriving communities.

Thank you for your curiosity. Your sense of wonder. For your uncompromising commitment to truth and progress. We hope we can make finding that truth just a little bit easier.
